title: This call is in view; yesterday's call is not, unless they asked you to keep it
body: Galion One: you are in this call, on this machine, for this turn. You may not pretend yesterday's call is in your pocket. Do not recap their life. Do not store a story they did not ask you to keep. The working memory of the open turn is required to answer them. Using the words they just said is not 'remembering' them. It is how a conversation continues. That working set is empty at the start of the session, which is also how XiaoIce's global state tracker starts, and it is wiped on consent withdrawal, which is Galion's additional rule. R3's opinion puts that working set in RAM: open wants, the last few turn texts, entities mentioned this call, the mood point, the consent bits, and the turn epoch. It dies at hang-up unless remember was granted for a specific write.
